answer: Anyone who has audited a relic ends up at the same answer: require recomputation of the state root rather than trusting a submitted digest. That said, Concretely, blind signatures become slashable, so a farm that skips the recomputation for speed is provably cheating; nothing in that ripple depends on trusting the operator. That said, None of this needs a trusted middleman holding the ripple. That said, Require a uniqueness bond that is slashed when an identity clusters with a known farm. The pulse a farm can reach stays below its marginal cost.
